description: Scratch targeted-repair candidate: one dark-clothed upright reaching-person asset is reused in three distinct source roles under the parent-agent pose/design delegation. Existing renderer geometry owns two aligned upper dots, one vertical continuation, two open ground surfaces, an upper upright instance and two separately placed 180-degree-rotated lower instances. Canvas coordinates are illustrative layout pixels, not centimetres or Earth measurements. Actual repaired near-sole pixels set contact translations without stretching. The initial clothing-loss failure remains preserved; repaired clothing contours are complete in author observations, but fine bright hair/shoe edge remnants remain on a dark background. No independent acceptance or no-halo claim is made.

authoritativeText.text:
例如，几何中经过任意两个不同的点有一条而且只有一条直线。
实际作图时，仅仅在两个点离得不很近的情况下，才能相信经过图上两个已知点只能作一条直线（图 74）。
可以设想一下：在莫斯科学校的教室里，沿铅直方向上下作两个点，距离为 $10\,\mathrm{cm}$（图 75）。

从几何的观点来说，连接这两点的直线通过地球并且穿过地表面以后，应当到达某一确定的点。
实际上，我们不能完全准确地指出这一点。
它的位置在太平洋的南部，但是只能指出它的大概位置。

3. 第一部系统的几何学教程（已经失传）是公元前五世纪的后半叶由希腊希俄斯的希波克拉图编写的。
公元前三世纪，古希腊几何学家获得的成就，在欧几里得著名的《几何原本》里得到了完整的反映。

欧几里得试图给所有几何概念都下定义。
他完全没有注意到那些无需定义而予以承认的基本概念。
正是由于这个缘故，他对最简单的概念所下的定义有时是极其混乱的。

例如，典型的有这样的定义：“线是没有宽度的长度”，“直线对于它所有的点的位置而言是均匀排列的线”。

inventory.description: Frozen source has one long approximately vertical continuation through two dots and both surfaces, extending above the dots and below both lower heads. Draft regularizes old ink wobble to a straight label-free segment; no geographical exit coordinate is added.

Both separately observed source dots above the upper ground are retained and related within this group. Their56-pixel draft separation is a layout choice, not the text's10cm converted to a canvas/Earth scale.
One separate open upper ground curve with both ends in frame; center higher on the page. Curve is a modern illustrative regularization with no measured Earth radius.

Separate source role: one upright person above the upper surface, chiefly left of the line, reaching toward it. Repaired actual canonical asset has complete dark shoulder/sleeve/torso contours, head, both hands and both shoes. Near-sole anchor is observed at raster377.5,1410; fit uses one uniform90/1024 scale. Fine bright hair/shoe edge remnants remain pending independent visual judgment.

Upper person's repaired near-sole anchor at generated raster377.5,1410 is translated to the upper curve at layout275.1787109375,715.3358849741408. Repaired far sole at raster559,1372 remains about2.951layout pixels above the curve because the generated stance is not level; explicit contact limitation, not source geometry. No stretching or added drawn body.
Second separate open lower ground curve far below the upper one, with center lower on the page and both boundary endpoints visible. Line passes through it; not a closed globe.

Distinct lower-left source role, not omitted by reuse: repaired actual canonical upright asset in its own frame rotated exactly180degrees. Near sole is placed at lower curve layout271.8212890625,162.78981828689575; actual far sole differs by about3.949layout pixels. Full head below feet requires rendered visual evidence; no independent acceptance is claimed.

Distinct lower-right source role: third repaired actual-asset instance, independently translated and exactly180degree rotated. Same-person/pose normalization is parent-agent delegation under existing ticket/Charter, not direct human item-by-item confirmation or a source identity claim. Near sole is placed at lower curve layout391.8212890625,163.75518631619627; actual far sole differs by about2.647layout pixels.

Both lower instances have their observed near soles at the lower surface and heads below feet. Far soles remain near but not exactly on the curve as explicitly recorded. Principal bodies lie on different sides of the connecting line; actual preview must show clearance and complete bodies. Counts do not replace contact evidence.

All line extensions, both ends of each surface, upper whole body and both lower whole bodies are source obligations. Actual fit boxes remain wholly in the canvas; previews must show real alpha footprints, inversion and non-clipping. Initial clothing-loss failure is preserved separately; repaired fine edge remnants and unequal-sole contacts remain explicit visual limitations.
